verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.

method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in fixed native whole CSR refinery fixed historical frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.

Unclassified riverbank source relief may contain wall/canopy artifacts and does not resolve historical refinery foundations, river levels or floor grades. Exact construction-grade classification is unspecified; source field does not certify ground contact.
